vintagedelight.jei.info.organic_compost: Fermented organic mash, used as an enhanced fertilizer or to make compost.
vintagedelight.jei.info.salt_layer: Grows on top of an Evaporator that has water beside it, one layer at a time up to 8. Salt Dust used on a layer adds one. Breaking it gives one Salt Dust per layer.
vintagedelight.jei.info.cheese_mold: Put 4 Cheese Curds into the Cheese Mold by hand or with a hopper from above. About 7 minutes later they set into a Cheese Wheel. Take it out with an empty hand or with a hopper below.
vintagedelight.jei.info.jar_stacking: Up to 4 of the same jar fit in one block: use a jar on a placed jar of its kind (not sneaking). Use the stack with an empty hand to take one back.
